_comment: Permanent fixture for the R37 regression pair (test_regressions.py). A real run's evidence lives in work/<source>/lexicon_evidence.json and is produced only by lexicon.py --find.

diaphor.quote: Diaphoresis is profuse sweating that accompanies shock states.

conson.quote: consonant (as opposed to just consonant-short vowel)
conson._why: R67 fixture: a fragment of a FOOTNOTE — an occurrence with no defining cue at all

shortv.quote: short vowels are shown above, where you can easily see and hear the correspondence
shortv._why: R67 fixture: says where the vowels are PRINTED, not what they are — the cue 'are' is followed by a presentation verb, which is exactly how this slipped a naive cue test

resultdisp.quote: resultant displacement is represented by the arrow labeled DR in Fig. 3-6
resultdisp._why: R67 fixture: physics ch3, 2026-09-03 — a representation verb, describing a FIGURE

vowelq.quote: vowel quality is the easiest way to distinguish between s and S
vowelq._why: R67 fixture: Arabic 2026-09-04 — says what the term is USEFUL FOR, 82 pages from the mark
